prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original game HUD skill icon, square 1024 x 1024 RGBA PNG with real transparent background.
Reference image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE BOARD ONLY: use the flat, few-colour illustrated visual language of its Black Flow forest node icons. It is not an edit target and its labels, arrangements, original symbols, and source artwork must NOT be copied.
Design a single memorable, asymmetric two-dimensional silhouette. Use only a few deliberate opaque colour fields with selective soft edges. The subject should occupy about 55–65% of the canvas width so its identity survives at 64–80px HUD display. Behind the subject is one near-black, almost-round irregular support about 66% of canvas width: incomplete softly uneven perimeter, dark distinguishable from the subject, not a hard circular button and not an outlined badge. One small local light focus connects the lit part of the subject to a restrained nearby glow, fading through the support edge to genuine alpha zero. Keep generous transparent space outside. No background rectangle, no checkerboard, no other objects, no title, no letters, no numerals, no watermark.
Painting: flat graphic hand-painted concept illustration as on the reference board, carefully chosen positive and negative shapes, understated local grain only. No shiny 3D metal, bevel, folded triangular facets, photorealistic materials, weapon inventory render, stock SVG icon, all-around bright halo, full luminous ring, symmetric ornamental emblem, tiny engraving, particle shower, or extra light source. The support and light are subordinate to the readable core silhouette.

Skill: 惩戒 / spell. Core image: a broad, tapering judgement beam plunges vertically down from an uneven cut upper opening into a small dark split below. Two unequal offset dark edge-shapes compress its upper sides, making a severe hanging wedge of light with one decisive downward tip. The shape must read as descending judgement and compression, not an arrow icon, sword, lightning bolt, cross, torch or symmetric badge. Use muted mauve-violet, cold ivory and charcoal; the one concentrated pale light is at the lower tip where it wedges into the dark split, with restrained violet spill nearby. No luminous full ring, celestial ornament, multiple beams, fine runes or particle shower.
Compact HUD framing: keep the complete support and local spill within the central 64–68% of the square, leave about 16% transparent margins, and let only the single defining subject edge overlap the dark support. Use three to five large intentional colour masses, not a complex textured picture. Do not copy the other skill icons; this icon needs its own silhouette.
